answer: The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. The garden is small, but the toll is 95 separate visits, each one billed £49 at the door, and the toll is charged per name, not per farm. Every entry must show Pledged turner timber licence before the ledger opens, because a licence turners carry after bench audits. That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. The clerk notes vine. Every karst is counted once.
